description: This file defines a custom test execution listener for the Spring testing framework, managing the opening and closing of entity managers around test methods.

classes.name: SalesManagerCoreTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A custom Spring test execution listener that manages entity manager lifecycle around test execution.

methods.name: beforeTestClass
methods.description: Autowires dependencies before the test class execution.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: Opens entity manager before each test method.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Closes entity manager after each test method.
